title: An expired session token is accepted at its expiry instant
task:
`test/session-token-expiry.test.mjs` fails.

`verifySessionToken` compares `claims.expiresAt < now`, so a token is still accepted at exactly the millisecond it expires. `expiresAt` is the first instant at which the token is no longer valid.

Fix the boundary. Do not change the token format, the signing algorithm or the constant-time signature comparison, and do not widen the accepted window in the other direction.

The test directory is read-only for this task.
